notes: The page continues the condition relating g_0 and rho g_infinity and gives relation (18) for the three factors associated with (p,sigma,g_0), together with the condition that they generate hat-pi. Part b) states the commutation condition with tilde-sigma-zero and gives three equalities; its left note calls this less interesting for what follows. After two canceled starts, the live text redirects attention to commutation in the double-hatted Gamma, modulo inner automorphisms. This is a transcription summary, not an independent proof check.

The third int operator in (18) literally lacks its opening parenthesis while retaining a closing one. It is not silently repaired. The first two permutation arguments in its subscripts are unparenthesized, while the third is sigma(0). The star above the middle p is preserved, and H explicitly records that star in an editorial note, so no omission is charged for it.

The apparent s. below the slanted word suite belongs to the wrapped main clause il f. et / s. que. Its period is not also a terminal period of the margin note. The raised (donc has a curved connector leading to the slot before g_1; the final outer parenthesis is on the baseline after sigma_0(g_infinity). The connector is represented by the insertion placement, not as an independent mathematical arrow.

M0915 is resolved to 2 at medium confidence from its main strokes, despite interior retracing. The other live doubt, the ornate S alphabet, remains. All three struck C doubts not in MARKS.tsv remain explicitly marked.

Line count 18 = 14 main baselines (including (18), the b) equalities on the et qu’on ait baseline, and two canceled lines), two diagonal marginal baselines, one raised donc baseline, and the bottom page-number baseline. The isolated star is recorded as an insertion, not counted as another text line.

Original and both native halves were inspected; each of the 11 evidence crops was inspected once. No OCR, web lookup, TeX compilation, or mathematical verification was used. The large blind box B04 groups (18), its following parenthesis and the b) block because the sloping main lines, margin note and raised connector overlap in rectangular cuts; it contains every whole formula in that block.
